verse.text: Good people leave an inheritance to their grandchildren, but the sinner's wealth passes to the godly.

reflection: Legacy isn't measured in the size of a bank account but in the character we hand down—the way we treat our wives, keep our word, and show up for the small moments. Every bedtime story, every apology, every Saturday spent teaching a kid to change a tire is you quietly building an inheritance that outlasts you. Start today: what's one habit or value you want your grandkids to inherit from you, even if they never meet you?
